experiment: #16 edit-RL (E2.f): correctness-preserving SOURCE edits scored by the verifier

speedup.note: every correct edit that reached the bench was SLOWER than the autotuned baseline (max 0.18x = ~5x slower)

verdict: HONEST NEGATIVE (E2.f kill criterion). Two-thirds of the policy's SEARCH/REPLACE edits did not even apply (the 32B could not reproduce exact source lines); the third that applied were correct-but-~5x-slower or broke correctness (caught by the gate battery). No edit beat the autotuned config.
interpretation: Confirms the central E2 thesis: source generation/editing is the WEAKEST RL action space, which is exactly why the project pivoted to config-search. The verifier worked perfectly (rejected every incorrect edit; paid speedup only after contracts). The autotuning win (config-RL) stands as the Asset-3 result; edit-RL is the speculative upside arm that did not pay out, as anticipated.
